DREAMS_BASE_RESTFUL_DREAM.why: Restful Dream is learned automatically with Dreams, but using it requires a 10-minute ritual, touch, one willing creature and 1 CP. Its benefits follow that creature's next completed short rest, at most once per long rest. Acquisition does not apply those benefits. The combat table has no ritual-to-rest executor for this ability; the saving throw, ordinary disturbance choice and recovery-check benefit remain unimplemented.
